title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #20

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah Al-Fatiha have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 4
   D. 5

2. How many verses does Surah Al-Falaq have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 3
   C. 5
   D. 4

3. Why did people leave their valuables with Muhammad (S.A.W.) before Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Because they trusted him
   B. Because he lived in the mountain
   C. Because he was the richest
   D. Because he was afraid

4. What is a hadith? (1 mark)
   A. A chapter of the Qur'an
   B. A type of prayer
   C. A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   D. A Muslim festival

5. Which is an example of copying the Prophet's kindness? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to greet people
   B. Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   C. Teasing a friend
   D. Hiding a friend's book

6. What does "Bismillah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is the Greatest
   B. In the name of Allah
   C. Glory be to Allah
   D. All praise is for Allah

7. What can someone say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Astaghfirullah only
   B. Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   C. Allahu Akbar
   D. Nothing

8. Which time is most important for a child to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Only after playing
   B. Only on Sunday
   C. Only after a visit to the dentist
   D. Before going to bed

9. What is oral hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Cleaning the room
   B. Washing feet
   C. Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   D. Cleaning clothes

10. Why should a Muslim not cheat in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   B. Referees are strict
   C. Cheating is a Sunnah
   D. Cheating is fun

11. The Prophet (S.A.W.) is reported to have raced with which wife? (1 mark)
   A. Hafsa (R.A.)
   B. Khadija (R.A.)
   C. Aisha (R.A.)
   D. Safiyya (R.A.)

12. Which dua matches the name As-Salam? (1 mark)
   A. Give me many toys
   B. Let me win
   C. Make me famous
   D. Grant us peace in our home and country

13. Which of these is a mistake about Allah's names? (1 mark)
   A. Learning them
   B. Teaching them
   C. Thinking Allah is like a human being
   D. Using them in dua

14. Which two names come from the word "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   B. Ar-Rahman and Al-Malik
   C. Al-Malik and As-Salam
   D. As-Sami' and Al-Basir

15. Belief in angels is one of the pillars of (1 mark)
   A. Islam only
   B. Zakat
   C. Iman
   D. Hajj

16. Why should belief in Raqib and Atid help us behave well? (1 mark)
   A. Our words and actions are recorded
   B. They give sweets
   C. They punish us at once
   D. They laugh at us

17. Eid al-Adha reminds us of the obedience of (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim and Ismail
   B. Nuh and Lut
   C. Adam and Hawa
   D. Musa and Harun

18. Which is a health reason for washing away najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. It stops rain
   B. It makes food taste sweet
   C. It makes us taller
   D. It prevents diseases like diarrhoea

19. Which of these breaks wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Talking
   B. Sweating
   C. Eating
   D. Passing wind

20. Which is a condition and not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Taslim
   B. Sujud
   C. Fatiha
   D. Covering the awrah

21. What is qiyam? (1 mark)
   A. Prostration
   B. Bowing
   C. Sitting
   D. Standing

22. What do we say in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   D. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim

23. Why do animals give us benefit? (1 mark)
   A. They only eat
   B. They are useless
   C. They give us food, milk, work and transport
   D. They cannot help

24. Which is a safe practice around stray dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Chase them
   B. Tease them
   C. Feed them by hand
   D. Do not go near them and tell an adult

25. What does the Qur'an (7:26) say is the best clothing? (1 mark)
   A. The clothing of righteousness
   B. The newest
   C. The most expensive
   D. The brightest

26. What is a kofia? (1 mark)
   A. A coat
   B. A cap
   C. A belt
   D. A shoe

27. Which is a dressing trend to avoid? (1 mark)
   A. Simple kanzu
   B. Clean uniform
   C. Neat trousers
   D. Clothes worn to show off

28. Which statement about dress is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody has rules
   B. Boys also have rules of modesty
   C. Rules are only for adults
   D. Only girls have rules

29. How can too much screen time affect a child? (1 mark)
   A. Improves health
   B. Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   C. Makes them taller
   D. Helps prayer

30. What is integrity in media use? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding
   B. Copying work
   C. Doing right even when nobody is watching
   D. Cheating

31. Which of these is print media? (1 mark)
   A. Radio
   B. Newspaper
   C. Television
   D. Film

32. Which of these is a manner of dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ask with humility and hope
   B. Give up quickly
   C. Shout
   D. Demand

33. What do we say at the end of a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Amin
   C. Goodbye
   D. Bismillah

34. Which is a way to help parents at home? (1 mark)
   A. Break things
   B. Sweep and wash dishes
   C. Hide
   D. Complain

35. Even if parents command wrong, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Leave home
   B. Insult them
   C. Ignore them
   D. Still treat them kindly in worldly matters

36. What does the hadith say about keeping family ties? (1 mark)
   A. It increases provision and life
   B. It causes trouble
   C. It reduces provision
   D. It has no effect

37. About how old was the Prophet at the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. About forty
   B. About ten
   C. About sixty
   D. About twenty

38. What was the first word revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Give
   B. Fast
   C. Pray
   D. Iqra (Read)

39. What does "convert" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A trader
   B. A traveller
   C. A person who accepts a new faith
   D. A teacher

40. What does "As-Siddiq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rich one
   B. The old one
   C. The truthful one who believes
   D. The fast one

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives. (5 marks)

42. Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong. (4 marks)

43. Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave. (3 marks)

44. Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq? (3 marks)

45. Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an. (3 marks)

46. Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid. (2 marks)

47. Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care. (3 marks)

48. Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif. (4 marks)

49. Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour. (5 marks)

50. Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf. (3 marks)

51. Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names. (5 marks)

52. State four features of the Islamic code of dressing. (4 marks)

53. Describe what happened to Taif in later years. (3 marks)

54. Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah. (3 marks)

55. What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (2 marks)

56. Explain why parents should be fair among their children. (3 marks)

57. In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 7
   Al-Fatiha has seven verses.

2. C — 5
   Al-Falaq has five verses.

3. A — Because they trusted him
   He was called Al-Amin.

4. C — A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Hadith records what the Prophet said, did or approved.

5. B — Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   Kindness means caring for others.

6. B — In the name of Allah
   Bismillah means "In the name of Allah".

7. B — Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   The Prophet taught this for one who forgets.

8. D — Before going to bed
   Less saliva flows during sleep.

9. C — Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   Oral means mouth.

10. A — Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   Honesty applies in games too.

11. C — Aisha (R.A.)
   Reports say he raced Aisha.

12. D — Grant us peace in our home and country
   As-Salam is the Source of Peace.

13. C — Thinking Allah is like a human being
   Nothing is like Allah.

14. A — Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   Rahmah means mercy.

15. C — Iman
   The six pillars of Iman include angels.

16. A — Our words and actions are recorded
   We try to speak and do good.

17. A — Ibrahim and Ismail
   It remembers the sacrifice of a ram.

18. D — It prevents diseases like diarrhoea
   Cleanliness prevents germs.

19. D — Passing wind
   Anything from the front or back passage breaks wudhu.

20. D — Covering the awrah
   It is met before the prayer starts.

21. D — Standing
   Qiyam means standing.

22. C — Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

23. C — They give us food, milk, work and transport
   Animals serve people.

24. D — Do not go near them and tell an adult
   Some animals may bite.

25. A — The clothing of righteousness
   Good character is best.

26. B — A cap
   A kofia is a cap.

27. D — Clothes worn to show off
   Showing off is disliked.

28. B — Boys also have rules of modesty
   Both boys and girls dress modestly.

29. B — Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   Excess is harmful.

30. C — Doing right even when nobody is watching
   Allah sees everything.

31. B — Newspaper
   Print media is printed on paper.

32. A — Ask with humility and hope
   Dua is humble.

33. B — Amin
   Amin means "O Allah, accept".

34. B — Sweep and wash dishes
   Helping is a duty.

35. D — Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   Qur'an 31:15.

36. A — It increases provision and life
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

37. A — About forty
   He was about forty.

38. D — Iqra (Read)
   Iqra means read.

39. C — A person who accepts a new faith
   A convert changes beliefs.

40. C — The truthful one who believes
   Abu Bakr's title.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet told parents to fear Allah and be fair among children. Favouring one causes jealousy and hurt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for jealousy, 1 mark for fairness.

57. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.
